Validate Coverage

Validate coverage using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

validate_coverage(rows, cases, trials, conditions)

Example input

{
  "rows": [
    {
      "case_id": "direct-answer",
      "trial": 1,
      "condition": "baseline"
    }
  ],
  "cases": [
    "direct-answer"
  ],
  "trials": 3,
  "conditions": [
    "baseline",
    "candidate"
  ]
}

Example output

{
  "complete": false,
  "missing": [
    [
      "direct-answer",
      1,
      "candidate"
    ],
    [
      "direct-answer",
      2,
      "baseline"
    ],
    [
      "direct-answer",
      2,
      "candidate"
    ],
    [
      "direct-answer",
      3,
      "baseline"
    ],
    [
      "direct-answer",
      3,
      "candidate"
    ]
  ],
  "unexpected": [],
  "duplicates": 0
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py validate_coverage < examples/validate-coverage.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
